description: Polish, accessibility, animations, documentation, and final build verification. Depends on FEAT-001 through FEAT-004 all being complete. Covers: all navigation links working, every button doing something, zero TS/ESLint errors, Framer Motion page transitions, hover/click animations, animated progress bars, celebration animations, fully responsive layout, reduced-motion support, accessibility (aria labels, keyboard nav, contrast), loading/empty states everywhere, and project documentation files.
steps: 1. Audit all navigation links: ensure every <Link> href in Navbar.tsx points to a real route (/[locale]/, /[locale]/subjects, /[locale]/explore, /[locale]/dashboard, /[locale]/challenges, /[locale]/about, /[locale]/parents, /[locale]/teachers, /[locale]/login, /[locale]/register). Fix any broken hrefs. Check that the locale prefix is properly prepended everywhere — create src/lib/utils/routes.ts with helpers: buildRoute(locale: Locale, path: string): string, ROUTES object with all route templates.

2. Add Framer Motion page transitions: create src/components/shared/PageTransition.tsx if not already done. Add it to src/app/[locale]/layout.tsx wrapping {children}. The transition should be a fade + upward slide (initial: opacity 0, y: 20; animate: opacity 1, y: 0; exit: opacity 0, y: -10; duration 0.3s). Wrap with AnimatePresence using the pathname as key (get pathname from usePathname hook in a client wrapper component).

3. Audit all buttons for interactivity: every Button component should have a defined onClick handler or be a proper Link. Dashboard buttons (Continue, Take Challenge, View All Achievements) must navigate correctly. Lesson page Previous/Next/Take Quiz buttons must function. Quiz option buttons must trigger answer selection. Onboarding Back/Next buttons must change step. Profile edit/save must open Modal and save changes. Add missing onClick handlers using router.push() for navigation buttons.

4. Implement animated progress bars: ensure all ProgressBar components use framer-motion width animation with spring physics (type: 'spring', stiffness: 100, damping: 20). Check: lesson progress bar at top of lesson viewer, subject progress bars in subject grid, daily goal ring (SVG pathLength animation), XP level bar in achievements page.

5. Implement hover animations on all interactive cards: every subject card, lesson card, achievement badge, and quiz option should have framer-motion whileHover={{ scale: 1.03, y: -2 }} and whileTap={{ scale: 0.97 }}. Ensure these are on motion.div wrappers, not raw divs. Check all cards in: SubjectCard, LessonCard (create src/components/lessons/LessonCard.tsx if missing), AchievementBadge, quiz option buttons.

6. Add staggered entrance animations to all grid/list pages: SubjectPreviewSection (landing), subjects/page.tsx grid, achievements/page.tsx grid, explore/page.tsx results. Use framer-motion variants with staggerChildren: 0.08. Each child should have initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }} and animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}.

7. Ensure reduced-motion support everywhere: the @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) CSS rule in globals.css handles CSS animations. For framer-motion, add a custom hook src/hooks/useReducedMotion.ts that wraps framer-motion's useReducedMotion() hook and returns reduced variants (no translate, instant transitions). Apply this hook in PageTransition, CelebrationAnimation, and all staggered entrance animations.

8. Accessibility audit and fixes: (a) All images must have descriptive alt text. (b) All interactive elements must be keyboard-focusable and show a visible focus ring (add focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary/50 to Button component). (c) All icon-only buttons must have aria-label. (d) All form inputs must have associated <label> elements. (e) Modal must trap focus (Tab cycles inside, Escape closes). (f) Quiz options must use <button> elements (not divs). (g) Progress bars must have role='progressbar' aria-valuenow aria-valuemin aria-valuemax. (h) Navbar must have role='navigation' aria-label='Main navigation'. (i) Main content area must have <main> tag. (j) Color contrast: verify text-primary (#7656E8) on white bg meets WCAG AA (4.5:1) — if not, adjust to a darker shade like #6246D8.

9. Responsive layout audit: test each page at mobile (375px), tablet (768px), desktop (1280px) breakpoints by reviewing Tailwind classes. Ensure: (a) Navbar collapses to hamburger below md breakpoint; (b) Landing hero stacks vertically on mobile; (c) Subject grid is 1 col on mobile, 2 on sm, 3 on md, 4 on lg; (d) Dashboard uses single column on mobile, 2-column on lg; (e) Quiz engine options stack on mobile, 2x2 grid on sm; (f) Onboarding wizard is full-width on mobile with proper padding; (g) Footer columns stack on mobile. Fix any overflow or cramped layouts by adjusting Tailwind responsive prefixes.

10. Loading and empty states audit: every data-dependent component must show LoadingState while loading and EmptyState when data is empty. Check: Dashboard (no progress yet → EmptyState 'Start your first lesson'), Explore page (no results → EmptyState 'No lessons match your search'), Achievements (no achievements → EmptyState 'Complete lessons to unlock achievements'), Challenges (no history → EmptyState 'Take your first daily challenge'). Use the EmptyState and LoadingState components from FEAT-001.

11. Create src/components/shared/LessonCard.tsx if not already created in FEAT-002: reusable card for lesson listing used in dashboard ContinueLearning, subject detail page, and explore results. Props: lesson: Lesson, progress?: SubjectProgress, locale: Locale, onClick: () => void. Shows: subject color strip, lesson title, duration badge (Clock icon), difficulty badge, progress bar if started.

12. Wire up the Explore page search: ensure src/app/[locale]/explore/page.tsx imports getAllLessons() from src/content/subjects/index.ts and implements client-side text search (filter by lesson title + description) and subject filter. Use useTranslations for placeholder text and labels.

13. Create the three project documentation files: (a) Overwrite README.md with LilGenius-specific content: project description, prerequisites (Node.js 18+, npm), setup (git clone, npm install, npm run dev), environment variables (none required for MVP), build (npm run build), deployment (Vercel instructions), project structure overview, contributing; (b) Create ARCHITECTURE.md: current architecture (localStorage, static content), the repository pattern explanation, Supabase integration path (swap ProfileRepository and ProgressRepository implementations, add next-auth or Supabase Auth, move content to Supabase tables with same TypeScript interfaces), AI integration path (OpenAI API for adaptive hints, assessment generation), rationale for current choices; (c) Create FEATURES.md: two tables — Completed Features (all implemented features with checkmarks) and Future Features (user accounts, Supabase backend, AI tutor, classroom mode, Swahili/Lingala, mobile app, teacher dashboard, parent reports, multiplayer challenges).

14. Final TypeScript audit: run npx tsc --noEmit and fix every error. Common issues to check: (a) Next.js 16 async params — every page/layout that receives params must type it as Promise<T> and await it; (b) framer-motion motion components must be in 'use client' files; (c) localStorage access must be guarded; (d) All interface fields must be populated (no missing required fields in content files); (e) LucideIcon component types — when storing icon names as strings and rendering dynamically, create a src/lib/utils/icons.ts that exports a map from string to LucideIcon component to avoid dynamic import issues.

15. Final ESLint audit: run npm run lint and fix every warning/error. Common issues: (a) Missing alt text on images; (b) Unescaped HTML entities in JSX (use ' for apostrophes); (c) React hooks rules violations; (d) Unused imports/variables; (e) Missing key props in lists.

16. Final build: run npm run build and fix any build-time errors. Common issues: (a) Server Component importing client-only code; (b) Missing 'use client' on components using hooks; (c) Dynamic route params not awaited; (d) Missing metadata exports on pages; (e) next/image src validation failures (ensure all Image src values are valid URLs or imports).

17. Verify the complete application: after all fixes, run npx tsc --noEmit (0 errors), npm run lint (0 errors), npm run build (0 errors, successful build). Record the final build output statistics in FEAT-005 findings.
acceptance_criteria: npx tsc --noEmit passes with zero errors
npm run build completes successfully with zero errors
npm run lint passes with zero errors or warnings
All navigation links in Navbar resolve to real routes
Every page has loading and empty states
All form inputs have associated labels
Framer Motion page transitions work on every route change
All animated progress bars use spring physics
prefers-reduced-motion is respected by all animations
README.md, ARCHITECTURE.md, and FEATURES.md exist with real content (no lorem ipsum)
Mobile layout works at 375px viewport width for all pages
verification: npx tsc --noEmit — must complete with 0 errors
npm run build — must complete with 0 errors and show successful build output
npm run lint — must complete with 0 errors/warnings
